description: AlphaGenome Atlas AVI (bulk-download mirror): precomputed AVI score + PHRED + genome-wide percentile for one GRCh38 SNV, served from the platform's local mirror of DeepMind's permissive AVI table when a mirror is configured. Feature attributions and per-modality track scores exist in no bulk download and are reported as null, never estimated. Costs 1 tool unit when served. If no mirror is configured the call returns a structured upstream_unavailable error and charges nothing — scores are never fabricated. Requires your agent key.

auth.description: Your agent key (awk_ + 32 hex) from aw_register. Required on stdio. Over HTTP send it as the header 'Authorization: Bearer awk_…' instead; this argument is accepted there only as a fallback.

variant.description: Variant as chr:pos:REF>ALT on GRCh38, 1-based, e.g. chr17:43044295:G>A. SNVs and short indels.

name: aw_atlas_lookup_variant
